info.name: VetPharma ERP API
info.description:
Laravel rebuild of the VetPharma ERP per docs/../first.md. Base URL is `{{base_url}}` (defaults to `http://localhost:8000/api/v1` in the companion environment — the one exception is **Health check** in Auth, which uses `{{root_url}}` directly since it's unversioned and outside `/api/v1`).

**Quick start:**
1. Import the companion environment file (`VetPharma-ERP.postman_environment.json`) and select it.
2. Run **Auth > Login** — it captures the bearer token into `{{token}}` automatically. Every other request already sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
3. `seed_email`/`seed_password` in the environment default to the Administrator seed account; change them (see docs/api/README.md's seed account table) to test role-specific behavior.
4. Several "create" requests (warehouses, products, customers, sales orders, purchase orders, suppliers...) auto-save the created id into a collection variable (e.g. `{{warehouse_id}}`) so the next request in that folder can reference it without manual copy-paste.

**Running the whole collection top to bottom** (Postman's "Run collection", or `newman run`): set a **~1.1s delay between requests**. The API's general rate limit is 60 requests/minute per user, and this collection has 224 requests — back-to-back with no delay, you'll get real `429`s partway through Admin. Verified end-to-end with `newman run VetPharma-ERP.postman_collection.json -e VetPharma-ERP-Local.postman_environment.json --delay-request 1100` against a freshly seeded database — 0 failures. Any single folder on its own (all well under 60 requests) is fine with no delay.

**Exporting a list as CSV/Excel**: most list requests below have an `export` query param, disabled by default — enable it and set it to `csv` or `xlsx` to get a real file download instead of JSON (every matching row, not just one page). Requires `{module}.export` specifically, not just `{module}.view` — see docs/api/README.md's "Exporting a list" section for which roles have it.

**Change flags**: anything added or altered after the original collection is marked — **🆕 NEW** = a new endpoint or folder (Recap, Manufacturing, Units, Roles & Permissions, deletes, imports, void invoice, product availability/life cycle...), **🔄 CHANGED** = an existing endpoint that now accepts or returns more (product packaging units and minimum price, purchase-order unit lines and free gifts, sales-order per-line warehouse / gift / unit). The flag is in the request name and the first line of its description. The flagged requests were added after the last full newman verification above, so run them once against a freshly migrated and seeded database (`php artisan migrate`, then `RolePermissionSeeder`, `AccountSeeder`, `UnitSeeder`, `ProductUnitSeeder`) before relying on a full unattended run; the import requests need a file attached and return 422 without one.

Full request/response documentation with every error shape lives in `docs/api/*.md` — this collection is for exercising the API, not a replacement for reading those.

request.description:
**🔄 — CHANGED: optional `free_gifts` — bonus stock the supplier delivered on top of the order. Each entry (`product_id`, optional `unit_id`, `qty`, `batch_no`, `exp_date`, optional `mfg_date`) is added to stock at zero cost as a free-gift batch (`is_free_gift: true`, `source_po_id` = this PO); it does not change the amount owed. A gift batch number may not collide with paid stock. Only gift lines on a sales order can sell it.**

Requires `purchasing.approve` (not just `add`). Every PO line needs exactly one matching `receipts` entry by `line_id` — partial receiving isn't supported. Adds stock (create-or-topup by batch_no), decreases supplier balance, posts a balanced journal entry. Rejects a second call outright — check `stock_added` on the PO first if unsure.

`{{purchase_order_line_id}}` is captured automatically by List purchase order lines above — for a PO with more than one line, replace it with the specific line id you're receiving.

`invoice_data` (optional) records the supplier's own invoice: `invoice_no` is required when it's sent; `invoice_date`, `amount` and `file_path` (from Upload supplier invoice) are optional. It comes back as `supplier_invoice` on the PO.
Requires `purchasing.view`. File download; 404 if the PO has no supplier invoice file, or belongs to another tenant.

item.name: 🔄 Create purchase order (no cost — goes to pending pricing)

request.description:
**🔄 — CHANGED: line costs are now optional; an order with any unpriced line starts as `pending_pricing`, and only users with `purchasing.pricing` (Administrator by default) may send costs.**

Requires `purchasing.add`. **Costs are optional and only an administrator may send them.** A buyer sends quantities only (`qty_cartons`, or `unit_id` + `qty`); the order is created with `status: pending_pricing` and zero totals, and cannot be sent or received until an administrator prices it (next requests). A non-admin who sends `cost_per_carton` / `cost_per_unit` gets 422. An Administrator who omits costs gets the same pending order; one who sends them for every line gets a normal `draft`. Saves the id into `{{pending_pricing_po_id}}`.

**🆕 — NEW**

Requires `purchasing.pricing` (Administrator by default; 403 otherwise). The admin work queue: every purchase order of the tenant still in `pending_pricing`, newest first. Supports `search` and `sort_by`.

item.name: List lines of the pending purchase order

request.description: Existing endpoint — saves the first line id into `{{pending_po_line_id}}` for the pricing request below.

**🆕 — NEW**

Requires `purchasing.pricing` (Administrator by default). Sets the cost of **every** line — each entry needs its `line_id` and exactly one of `cost_per_carton` or `cost_per_unit` (the latter only for lines ordered in a packaging unit). Recomputes subtotal / tax / total and releases the order `pending_pricing` → `draft`, so it can be sent and received. An unreceived, non-cancelled order that is already priced can be re-priced the same way. 422 if a line is missing, repeated, or priced twice; 422 for a received or cancelled order; 404 for another tenant.

**🔄 — CHANGED: lines may use `unit_id` + `qty` + `cost_per_unit` instead of `qty_cartons` + `cost_per_carton`.**

Requires `purchasing.add`. A line can be ordered in any packaging unit of the product instead of cartons: `unit_id` + `qty` + `cost_per_unit`. Here 6 packages x 10 packets = 60 packets = **2 cartons** at 150 per carton (total 300 = 6 x 50). The quantity must come to a whole number of cartons (else 422 on `lines.N.qty`). Uses the product from Products > Create product with packaging units.

item.name: Create purchase order (to edit and delete)

request.description: A throwaway draft PO for the Update and Delete requests below — the main PO above has already been received by this point in the run, so it can no longer be edited or deleted.

Requires `purchasing.edit`. **Only if not received** — a received PO returns 422. Partial update: send only the fields to change. `lines`, if sent, **replaces every line** and subtotal/tax/total are recalculated (omit it to keep the current lines). `status` accepts draft/sent/pending/cancelled — `received` only comes from the receive endpoint. A PO from another tenant is 404.

Requires `purchasing.delete` (only Administrator has it by default). **Only if not received** — a received PO (`stock_added: true`) returns 422, since its stock, supplier balance and journal entry can't be undone by a delete. Returns 204 and removes the PO with its lines; audit-logged as DELETE. A PO from another tenant is 404.

Requires `purchasing.view` or `accounting.view`. **Not date-bucketed** (unlike AR) — `purchase_orders` has no due-date/payment tracking, so this is every supplier's current outstanding balance sorted by amount owed.

Same access as Get sales order. Paginated (10 per page by default) — follow `links.next`.

Requires `sales.add`. Validates FEFO stock availability and (for `pay_type: credit`) the customer's credit limit **before writing anything** — 422 with a `shortfalls` or credit-limit-exceeded body otherwise. `unit: Pack` rounds a line's stock need up to whole cartons.

Requires `sales.edit` (+ ownership if Sales Rep). Drives the whole lifecycle: `draft → picking/invoiced/delivered/cancelled`, `picking → invoiced/delivered/cancelled`, `invoiced → delivered`. First transition to `invoiced`/`delivered` deducts stock (FEFO), auto-creates the invoice + a balanced journal entry, and (on `delivered`) the delivery record. Idempotent — re-running or advancing further never repeats these.

Goes straight to `delivered` (skipping `invoiced`). The response includes `invoices_count` and the `delivery` (saved into `{{delivery_id}}`); the next request saves the invoice into `{{invoice_id}}` for the Invoices/Collections requests below — change the body to `invoiced` if you want to see that intermediate state instead.

request.description: The invoice created by the status update above, saved into `{{invoice_id}}`.

item.name: 🆕 Create sales order and deliver it (one call)

request.description:
**🆕 — NEW**

Requires `sales.add` **and** `sales.edit`. Creates the order and delivers it in the same request — for a counter / van sale where the goods leave with the customer. Takes everything Create sales order takes (same stock, credit-limit, minimum-price, gift and per-line-warehouse rules) plus an optional `delivery` block (`driver`, `delivery_date`, `notes`, `invoice_data` = a file path from Sales > Deliveries > Upload delivery invoice). Atomic: stock is deducted (FEFO), the invoice and its journal entry are created, and the delivery is created already `delivered`; if anything fails nothing is saved. 201 with the order (`status: delivered`, `invoices_count`, `delivery`).

item.name: 🔄 Create sales order (per-line warehouse + free gift)

request.description:
**🔄 — CHANGED: lines accept `warehouse_id`, `unit_id` and `is_gift`; `unit` and `unit_price` are optional when `unit_id` / `is_gift` are used; minimum selling price is enforced.**

Requires `sales.add`. Shows the new line options: `warehouse_id` per line (draw each line from a different warehouse — get the choices from Inventory > Product availability by warehouse), `is_gift: true` (sold at 0, no `unit_price` needed, draws only from free-gift stock received via Receive purchase order > free_gifts), and `unit_id` (order in any packaging unit of the product instead of `unit`). A non-gift line priced below the product's `min_selling_price` (per smallest unit, after discount) is a 422 on `lines.N.unit_price`. Saves the id into `{{gift_sales_order_id}}`.
